abstract: This study examines the impact of generative AI, specifically ChatGPT's launch, on freelance labor markets. The research finds significant disruption to freelance writing work, with substantial declines in job postings and hourly rates observed within six months of ChatGPT's introduction, suggesting that generative AI tools create immediate competitive pressure on freelance workers in text-based tasks.
keyFindings: ChatGPT's launch caused a 21% decline in freelance writing job postings within 6 months.
Average hourly rates for freelance writing fell by 15% within 6 months following ChatGPT's launch.
The impact suggests generative AI creates immediate competitive pressure on freelance workers in text-based tasks.
